definitions.gloss: common expense fee; common area maintenance fee
definitions.explanation: A fee paid by tenants or owners for the maintenance of shared facilities and common areas in an apartment building or condominium.

examples.japanese: {共益費|きょうえきひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水道代|すいどうだい}→水道代：09544_suidoudai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{含|ふく}んでいる→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: The common expense fee includes the water bill.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧{8万円|はちまんえん}、{共益費|きょうえきひ}{3千円|さんぜんえん}。
examples.english: Rent 80,000 yen, common expense fee 3,000 yen.

examples.japanese: {共益費|きょうえきひ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{廊下|ろうか}→廊下：05005_rouka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{照明|しょうめい}→照明：03243_shoumei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{賄|まかな}われている→賄う：07873_makanau⟧。
examples.english: The hallway lighting is covered by the common expense fee.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{共益|きょうえき}→共益：noentry⟧ (common benefit) + ⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧ (expense, fee)

DIFFERENCE FROM ⟦{管理費|かんりひ}→管理費：06575_kanrihi⟧:
While often used interchangeably, technically:
- ⟦{管理費|かんりひ}→管理費：06575_kanrihi⟧ - more for management/administration
- {共益費|きょうえきひ} - more for shared utilities/facilities

In practice, many landlords use one or the other, and some use both.

WHAT IT TYPICALLY COVERS:
- ⟦{共用|きょうよう}→共用：21529_kyouyou⟧⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧ (common area electricity)
- ⟦{水道|すいどう}→水道：01058_suidou⟧⟦{代|だい}→代：28331_dai⟧ (water bills - sometimes)
- ⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧ (garbage disposal)
- ⟦{廊下|ろうか}→廊下：05005_rouka⟧/⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{清掃|せいそう}→清掃：04332_seisou⟧ (hallway/stairway cleaning)

PROPERTY LISTING TERMS:
- ⟦{賃料|ちんりょう}→賃料：30029_chinryou⟧：¥80,000 {共益費|きょうえきひ}：¥5,000
- {共益費|きょうえきひ}⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧ (common fee included in rent)
- {共益費|きょうえきひ}⟦なし→なし：03779_nashi⟧ (no common fee)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {共益費|きょうえきひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ (to pay the common expense fee)
- {共益費|きょうえきひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}→発生：03133_hassei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (a common fee applies)
- {共益費|きょうえきひ}⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧ (common fee charged separately)
